get.summary: Get marketing campaign and push analytics
get.description:
Aggregates campaign counts by status and type, the 10 most recent campaigns, push-notification totals (recipients, successes, failures) with a per-day breakdown, and segment/template counts, all over a trailing window.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check - this endpoint exposes marketing volume metrics to any caller who can reach it.

_Source: `app/api/marketing/analytics/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: targetApp
parameters.description: Filter to one app: customer or vendor

get.summary: List campaigns with filters and pagination
get.description:
Returns a paginated campaign list with each campaign's audience segments (with cached counts), ordered steps and template summaries, plus an execution count, filtered by status, type, target app and a name/description search.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/marketing/campaigns/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status: draft, active, paused, completed

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by type: one-time, drip, recurring, ab-test

parameters.name: targetApp
parameters.description: Filter by target app: customer or vendor

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on campaign name or description

post.description:
Creates a campaign in draft with its audience segments and at least one step. A/B campaigns must have at least 2 variants whose abPercentage values sum to exactly 100; recurring campaigns must supply a recurringPattern.

**Notes:** Creating a campaign does not send anything - it must be activated via /api/marketing/campaigns/{id}/activate. No handler-level auth check (withAuditLog only records); middleware enforces the session.

_Source: `app/api/marketing/campaigns/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

400.description: Validation failed or A/B-test / recurring rules broken

example.error: A/B test variant percentages must add up to 100

post.description:
Scheduler webhook that runs processCampaignExecutions, dispatching every pending CampaignExecution whose scheduledAt has arrived and scheduling follow-up drip steps. Returns how many executions were processed.

**Notes:** Major side effect: actually sends push notifications to customers/vendors. Intended to be called on a schedule by Pabbly; the request body is ignored.

_Source: `app/api/marketing/campaigns/process/route.ts`_

_Auth: `pabbly-secret`_

get.summary: Get one campaign with steps and executions
get.description:
Returns a campaign with its audience segments, ordered steps (including each step's notification template) and the 50 most recent executions.

**Notes:** No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/marketing/campaigns/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

put.summary: Update a draft or paused campaign
put.description:
Updates campaign metadata, schedule and (optionally) replaces its audience segments and step list. Active campaigns are rejected - they must be paused first. Payload is validated with zod.

**Notes:** Sending `steps` deletes all existing CampaignStep rows for the campaign and recreates them, so step ids change. No handler-level auth check (withAuditLog only records); middleware enforces the session.

_Source: `app/api/marketing/campaigns/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

400.description: Validation failed or campaign is active

example.error: Cannot edit an active campaign. Pause it first.

delete.description:
Permanently deletes the campaign. Active campaigns are rejected and must be paused or archived first.

**Notes:** Irreversible delete; steps, audiences and executions go with it via cascade. No handler-level auth check (withAuditLog only records); middleware enforces the session.

_Source: `app/api/marketing/campaigns/[id]/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

example.error: Cannot delete an active campaign. Pause or archive it first.

post.summary: Pick the winning variant of an A/B campaign
post.description:
Records the chosen campaign step as the A/B winner, stamps abWinnerPickedAt, and closes the campaign by setting status to completed and endAt to now. Only campaigns of type ab-test are accepted.

**Notes:** Wrapped in withAuditLog (entity CAMPAIGN) which logs when a session is present but performs no authentication - the route itself has No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/marketing/campaigns/[id]/ab-winner/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

400.description: winnerId missing, campaign is not an A/B test, or step not in campaign

example.error: Only A/B test campaigns can have a winner

post.summary: Activate a campaign and schedule its executions
post.description:
Flips a campaign to active and creates pending CampaignExecution rows: one for the first step for one-time, drip and recurring campaigns, or one per variant for ab-test campaigns. startAt is the campaign's future startAt if set, otherwise now.

**Notes:** Side effect: schedules real push-notification sends - the executions are picked up by /api/marketing/campaigns/process. No handler-level auth check (withAuditLog only records); middleware enforces the session. No request body is read.

_Source: `app/api/marketing/campaigns/[id]/activate/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

400.description: Already active or has no steps

example.error: Campaign must have at least one step

post.description:
Sets the campaign status to paused and cancels every pending CampaignExecution by marking it failed with errorMessage "Campaign paused". Returns how many executions were cancelled.

**Notes:** Cancelled executions are written as status "failed", not a distinct cancelled state. No handler-level auth check (withAuditLog only records); middleware enforces the session.

_Source: `app/api/marketing/campaigns/[id]/pause/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

example.error: Only active campaigns can be paused

get.summary: Get per-step and A/B stats for a campaign
get.description:
Returns campaign totals with an overall delivery rate, per-step send/success/failure counts with their executions, and for ab-test campaigns a variant-by-variant comparison including each variant's delivery rate.

**Notes:** abComparison is null for non-ab-test campaigns. No handler-level auth check.

_Source: `app/api/marketing/campaigns/[id]/stats/route.ts`_

_Auth: `none`_

ErrorEnvelope.description: Plain error envelope `{ error }` used by most routes. `error` is a human-readable message.

ErrorDetailsListEnvelope.description: Validation error envelope `{ error, details[] }`; `details` lists the individual field problems.

UnspecifiedObject.description: Response body shape not captured by the source re-audit (only the status code was detected). Any JSON object.

AnyObject.description: Arbitrary JSON object; the route forwards or stores it without declaring a shape.

segmentIds.description: Array of audience segment UUIDs; replaces the existing audience list entirely

steps.description: Full replacement step list; each item takes templateId (uuid), stepOrder (int >= 0), delayMinutes (int >= 0, default 0), abVariant (<=10 chars), abPercentage (1-100), titleOverride (<=255), bodyOverride

recurringPattern.description: { type: daily|weekly|monthly, time, dayOfWeek 0-6, dayOfMonth 1-31 } or null

recurringEnd.description: ISO datetime when the recurrence stops, or null

startAt.description: ISO datetime for the first send, or null

winnerId.description: UUID of the campaign step (variant) that won; must belong to this campaign

steps.description: At least one step: templateId (uuid), stepOrder (int >= 0), delayMinutes (default 0), abVariant, abPercentage (1-100), titleOverride, bodyOverride

recurringPattern.description: Required when type is recurring: { type: daily|weekly|monthly, time, dayOfWeek, dayOfMonth }

startAt.description: ISO datetime of the first send

Unauthorized.description: Unauthenticated - no valid admin session (NextAuth cookie), or the expected token/secret is missing or wrong. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

ServiceUnavailable.description: Service unavailable - a dependency or required configuration is not available. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

InternalServerError.description: Internal server error - unhandled failure inside the route handler. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

BadRequest.description: Bad request / validation error - a required field is missing or invalid. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

BadGateway.description: Upstream error - a dependent service call failed. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

NotFound.description: Not found - the referenced record does not exist. For operations whose description says *reconstructed from source*, only the status code was detected in the audit; the body shape shown is the codebase convention, not verified per route.

UntypedJsonBody.description: JSON body accepted as-is; the route does not declare a shape (forwarded upstream or validated inside the handler).

cookieAuth.name: next-auth.session-token
cookieAuth.description: NextAuth JWT session cookie from logging in to the admin panel. On HTTPS the cookie name is `__Secure-next-auth.session-token`.

cronBearer.description: `LINODE_CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token — every cron job goes through `assertCronAuth` in `lib/linode/cron-auth.ts`, which reads only this variable (despite some jobs being non-Linode).

unverifiedAccessToken.name: Authorization
unverifiedAccessToken.description: Legacy customer routes: an `accessToken` cookie or an `Authorization` header must be PRESENT, but the value is never verified. Not real authentication.

adsWebhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
adsWebhookSecret.description: `ADS_WEBHOOK_SECRET`, sent either as the `x-webhook-secret` header or as a `secret` field in the JSON body. If the env var is unset the route rejects every call with 401 (it does not fall through to unauthenticated access).

webhookSecret.name: x-webhook-secret
webhookSecret.description: Generic `x-webhook-secret` header check for an inbound webhook.

cronSecretBearer.description: `CRON_SECRET` as a bearer token, compared with `bearerMatches` in `lib/auth/secret-compare.ts`. Distinct from `cronBearer`, which uses `LINODE_CRON_SECRET`.
